statement: Inferred across each ten-second stopped-Puck capture window, 0x42 counts correspond to 266.1,266.1,265.6 and 265.7 reports/s for idle,lizard,mouse and keyboard; reconnect window 199.0 reports/s includes disconnection. These are counts divided by window length, NOT measured packet cadence, polling rate, inter-arrival timing, jitter or guaranteed steady-state frequency.
